title: S05T04 - Add Spec Kit and generic AGENTS-compatible adapters
description: Prove the adapter boundary beyond OpenSpec with Spec Kit artifacts and a generic manifest for repository-native spec, plan, task, and change layouts.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one Spec Kit fixture and one generic manifest import current specs, proposed work, and acceptance artifacts without core-code special cases.
Unsupported or ambiguous layouts fail with exact configuration guidance rather than guessed mappings.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
